saw_lines: Shoppers buying a bag or boot check the delivery cost before they click, and many leave when they cannot find it.
So the delivery answer must sit in the first line of the ad, or the buyer leaves before reading the price.
Your site lists shipping at 3,90 €, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery. Open the next batch of puffer ads with that answer in line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site lists shipping at 3,90 €, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer scrolling past never sees the cost. Open the next three ads with the shipping answer in line one.
